name: Notebook navigator
description: Folders, tags, shortcuts and recent notes beside a list of the notes in the one you pick, each with its date, first lines and first image, like Apple Notes or Bear. In the sidebar, in a tab, and as a phone screen.
author: Vaultite

sort.label: Sort notes by
sort.description: the order of a folder's or tag's notes, unless it has its own

subfolders.label: Show notes from subfolders
subfolders.description: a folder lists the notes in its subfolders too, and counts them

shortcuts.label: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: folders and tags at the top, as folder:<path> or tag:<name>

sorts.label: Sort per folder
sorts.description: a folder's or tag's own order: folder:<path> or tag:<name> to modified, created or title
